description: Start the full pipeline for an existing business profile. This runs use cases through implementation plan generation asynchronously and returns a jobId; poll with get_generation_status.

businessProfileId.description: The business profile ID to run through the pipeline.

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

specialInstructions.description: Optional execution guidance for downstream generations.

strategicInitiativeId.description: Optional strategic initiative ID to bias use-case selection.

name: trigger_full_pipeline
